questions.text: What are the differences between Public finance and Personal finance?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the differences between Public finance and Personal finance? (June 2015, Exam 2-2024, 2017) (Difficult)

answer.value:
Private Finance
Income and expenditure of one person or one family.
Calculate income and then spend it accordingly.
Transactions are kept confidential.
Individual or a family saves money, it will supplement their prosperity
Public Finance
Relates to the income and expenditure of the government.
Calculates its expenditure first and then adjusts its income.
Public financial matters are discussed in the legislative houses.
If Government saves money, growth is stunted.
